slides.title: What you do when you're hurt, by Moon sign

visual.caption: The sky on 30 Sep 2026, from the date alone · the Moon in Taurus

slides.line: You react first and sort it out afterward. It flares fast, and it's over fast.
slides.help: Say what hurt before you say what made you angry.

slides.line: You go quiet and dig in. Slow to get upset, and slower to let it go.
slides.help: Tell them what would help you move on.

slides.line: You talk it through with everyone, or make a joke and change the subject.
slides.help: Say the one sentence that's really bothering you.

slides.line: You pull back into your shell, and you remember it for a long time.
slides.help: Let one person in before the shell closes.

slides.line: Your pride takes it hardest. You need them to see it, but you won't ask.
slides.help: Ask for the attention you need, out loud.

slides.line: You go over it in detail and look for what you did wrong.
slides.help: Tell someone before you've worked it all out.

slides.line: You smooth it over and see their side before your own.
slides.help: Say what you want first, then listen to them.

slides.line: You keep it private and hold on to it for a long time.
slides.help: Say it out loud instead of keeping score.

slides.line: You say exactly what you think, then go somewhere to cool off.
slides.help: Come back and finish the conversation.

slides.line: You go cold and get back to work, as if nothing happened.
slides.help: Let it slow you down for a day.

slides.line: You step back and analyse it, as if it happened to someone else.
slides.help: Say how it felt, not what you think about it.

slides.line: You feel all of it, theirs too, then disappear for a while.
slides.help: Say no to one thing, and rest.

slides.title: The Moon changes sign every two or three days.
slides.body: Your birth date usually settles yours. If you were born on a day it changed, your birth time does.
